decision: checked each of the five reported blockers against the code before designing
why: two of the five were misdiagnosed, and fixing the stated cause would have fixed nothing
evidence: three explorer maps; src/web/server.ts:2566, src/headless-browser.ts, packages/canvas/src/shot.ts
result: MCP missing for every session not just canvas; screenshot tool already has the browser libs; Paused is by design

decision: a prototype is stored as an ordinary embed with a prototype.invalid address, not a new object type
why: the previous release parses the op log strictly, so a new type or key would make a rollback unable to read the workspace

decision: comment element anchors go in a side file keyed by comment id; context elements go into the prompt block text
why: same rollback rule: CommentSchema and the stored refs are strict

decision: prototypes are static files only, no per-prototype process
why: served by Codeman with nothing to keep alive; a server-backed prototype is left as an open question

decision: one injected bridge script for every canvas frame replaces the Escape relay
why: element pick, lasso and Q forwarding then work for proxied embeds and prototypes with one protocol
